change: Low-profile circular shortcut button and narrower wheel center gap
behavior: The floating shortcut button is a 40dp muted circle with an 18dp Canvas command glyph and a subtle border. Its parent keeps the 48dp touch/drag target and stable wheel anchor. Idle opacity remains 50%. Both Grid and Circular modes share the face; active Grid and the idle root wheel show Close instead of AssistiveTouch rings. The transparent hub/ring gap is about 4dp at the normal 196dp wheel diameter. The gap is neutral for steering, and tapping it neither executes a command nor closes the menu. Group Back and highlighted-command previews remain.
phone_install: Installed release 43 on S22+ RFCT21390SD via USB; installed APK checksum matches; app data preserved; app not launched.
source_commit: Uncommitted source changes based on signed commit 19f60a163e
